# simpleaudit-docs

Documentation for simpleaudit-docs

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first local audit using the CLI or a minimal Python script.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install SimpleAudit and verify your Python 3.11+ environment setup.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): Understand the core audit loop, judge registry, and scenario structure.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Learn how adversarial probing and LLM-as-a-judge metrics work.
